posts.text:
🚨🇺🇸 BREAKING: LaGuardia's control tower reportedly warned pilots of a possible shoulder-fired missile near the airport tonight  

The alert went out around 630 p.m. Eastern for an area just east of the airport.   

It flagged a MANPADS, short for man-portable air defense system, which is a missile launcher light enough for one person to carry on their shoulder and built to shoot down aircraft.   

The American Stinger is the best-known example.  There's no word yet on what triggered it.   

In July the same tower issued a MANPADS alert that police called a hoax within minutes, after an anonymous caller claimed to have a rocket launcher by a runway.  

Hopefully this is another false alarm, but the night before Thanksgiving with planes packed full is a terrible time to find out.  

Writer: Daniel https://t.co/wuAHMKhgYq

Taxi drivers take us to the hospital when a baby is on the way and to urgent care when the flu strikes. When you spend your days getting everyone else where they need to be, finding the time to see a doctor yourself isn’t always easy.

That’s why @nyctaxi is partnering with @MetroPlusHealth and @PANYNJ to bring health care and essential resources directly to the 180,000 cab drivers who keep this city moving.

With new Driver Health Hubs at JFK and LaGuardia and mobile service vans across all five boroughs, drivers will have easier access to same-day doctor appointments, health screenings, health insurance and SNAP enrollment assistance, and more.

The people who take care of New Yorkers deserve a city that takes care of them, too.

U.S. MORTGAGE APPLICATIONS JUMP 6.1% DESPITE RATES RISING TO 7.38%

U.S. mortgage applications rose 6.1% in the week ended November 20, according to the Mortgage Bankers Association (MBA).

🔸 Purchase applications: +10.2%
🔸 Refinancing applications: +0.5%
🔸 Overall mortgage applications: +6.1%
🔸 30-year mortgage rate: 7.38%, up 3 basis points
